// Prepare HTML Email for Candidate Document Verification Request const input = $input.first().json; const candidateName = input.candidate_name || 'Candidate'; const candidateEmail = input.candidate_email; const positionTitle = input.position_title || 'Position'; const companyName = input.company_name || 'ScalePods'; const documents = Array.isArray(input.documents) ? input.documents : []; const customMessage = input.custom_message || 'Please submit these documents at your earliest convenience to proceed with your hiring process.'; const docListHtml = documents.map((doc, idx) => `
  • ${idx + 1}. ${doc}
    • `).join(''); const emailHtml = ` Document Verification Request

    ${companyName}

    Hiring & Onboarding Team

    Document Verification for ${positionTitle}

    Hello ${candidateName},

    Congratulations on successfully advancing through the interview stages for the ${positionTitle} role at ${companyName}.

    Before preparing your formal employment offer, we kindly require you to submit copies of the following verification documents:

      ${docListHtml}

    Instructions: ${customMessage}

    Please reply directly to this email with your attachments (PDF or clear image scans preferred).

    Warm regards,
    ${companyName} Talent Acquisition

    `; return { application_id: input.application_id, candidate_email: candidateEmail, candidate_name: candidateName, position_title: positionTitle, company_name: companyName, subject: `Action Required: Document Verification for ${positionTitle} | ${companyName}`, email_html: emailHtml, documents: documents };
